scope: All 47 requested country designs; only East Asia has active Phase A art integration.

records.name: China
records.mainRoute: Begin on a wide mountain observation terrace. The player crosses a stone path, climbs progressively higher ledges, rides a moving cliff platform, crosses a narrow rocky connection, and reaches a high observation point. The main route should include several safe resting ledges between difficult jumps.
records.optionalRoute: Create an elevated route across narrow pillar tops. Place a golden star on a remote observation platform. The bonus route reconnects before the finish.
records.signatureMechanic: Moving cliff lifts and precise high-altitude traversal
records.visualEnvironment: Create an enormous landscape of tall sandstone pillars rising through misty valleys. Use sculpted stone columns with vegetation growing on their upper surfaces. The foreground should contain wet-looking rock ledges, small trees, hanging roots, and natural stone paths. Place enormous mountain pillars in the background at different depths. Use soft clouds drifting between the columns. The environment should feel much taller than Japan's forested cliffs.
specificationGaps: Requested tier 5; current route measures tier 4.
Add and test exposed-ledge wind before approving the new target design.
records.notes: Active Phase A. Preserve the working route while art and revised mechanics are reviewed. Automated evidence describes the existing route, not approval of the new target specification.

records.name: Japan
records.mainRoute: Begin on a broad grassy island. Cross a simple gap, continue along a wooden bridge, traverse wide natural stone platforms, and finish at a scenic gateway.
records.optionalRoute: Create an ascending route of irregular grassy rocks leading to a floating golden star. The player should be able to return safely to the main path.
records.visualEnvironment: Preserve the existing Japan level. Maintain Mount Fuji, cherry blossom trees, traditional Japanese-inspired architecture, waterfalls, torii gates, stone lanterns, and grassy platforms. Improve the 3D terrain geometry, water, lighting, and background depth to match the approved cinematic reference.
specificationGaps: Requested beginner tier 1; preserved route measures tier 2.
Review lower-route steps without weakening the optional star route.
records.notes: Active Phase A. Preserve the working route while art and revised mechanics are reviewed. Automated evidence describes the existing route, not approval of the new target specification.

records.name: Mongolia
records.mainRoute: The player runs across broad grassy terrain, crosses shallow gullies, moves over natural stone ledges, and traverses a short river crossing. The route should feel expansive and mostly horizontal.
records.optionalRoute: Place a star on a small isolated hilltop reached through a series of short jumps.
records.signatureMechanic: Wind-assisted traversal and moving ground obstacles
records.visualEnvironment: Create vast grasslands under a huge blue sky. Include rolling green and golden hills, distant mountains, winding river sections, and scattered rock outcrops. Traditional ger structures may appear as background cultural references in appropriate locations. The scenery should be open, with very few tall structures. Avoid dense forests and large floating islands.
specificationGaps: Requested tier 2; current route measures tier 1.
Add and test the wooden river platform in the next gameplay pass.
records.notes: Active Phase A. Preserve the working route while art and revised mechanics are reviewed. Automated evidence describes the existing route, not approval of the new target specification.

records.name: North Korea
records.mainRoute: Begin on a broad volcanic ridge. Travel over rocky ledges, cross a narrow mountain pass, climb several natural steps, and follow a descending path toward the finish viewpoint.
records.optionalRoute: An elevated overlook contains a star and a view of the crater lake.
records.visualEnvironment: Create an alpine volcanic landscape with a large crater lake visible in the distance. Use dark volcanic rock, rugged ridgelines, sparse high-altitude vegetation, snow patches, and cool atmospheric lighting. Add distant mountains and clouds. Keep the level focused on physical geography rather than politics.
specificationGaps: Requested tier 4; current route measures tier 3.
Replace steam timing with warned loose-rock and ridge-wind traversal for the revised brief.
records.notes: Active Phase A. Preserve the working route while art and revised mechanics are reviewed. Automated evidence describes the existing route, not approval of the new target specification.

records.name: South Korea
records.mainRoute: Begin on a rooftop terrace. Cross a short pedestrian structure, ride a moving maintenance lift, traverse two building terraces, and descend toward a riverside finish.
records.optionalRoute: An elevated rooftop garden contains a star.

specificationGaps: Requested tier 3; current route measures tier 2.
